scope: MQTT runtime change (R17/R18; tasks 1.2, 2.4) and axum router fallback + bootstrap (R11/R12/R14; tasks 2.5, 5.1)

findings.summary: MqttStatePayload uses 'color' as an RGB object, but the existing published state uses 'color' as a hex string (src/mqtt.rs:132) — key collision.
findings.fix: Let HA read 'color' as the {r,g,b} object; drop or rename the legacy hex-string 'color' (the existing 'rgb' object already carries the value). State the resolved key set in the task.

findings.summary: Unknown paths under /api/ or /ws (no explicit route) fall through to serve_spa and, being extension-less, would return index.html (200) instead of 404.
findings.fix: In serve_spa, return 404 for a request path beginning with 'api/' or equal to 'ws' before the client-route index.html fallback.

verify_checks: CHECK-1: enabled->disabled exit path publishes retained 'offline' and clears discovery WHILE the client is still connected (before run_connection returns).
CHECK-2: commands_from_payload accepts HA {"state":"ON","brightness":n,"color":{r,g,b}} and disambiguates object-vs-string 'color'.
CHECK-3: bundle gzipped JS+CSS <= 50 KB measured after build (R15.1).
CHECK-4: HA marks the entity unavailable on ungraceful service stop via the retained LWT.
